## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC close and TRA execution

- 2022-05-02: Business combination between Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. and NuScale Power, LLC closes; PubCo (NuScale Power Corporation) executes the TRA with Fluor Enterprises (TRA Representative) and eight other TRA Holders (Japan NuScale Innovation, GS Energy, Next Tech 1 and 3 funds, Doosan Enerbility, Sargent & Lundy NuHoldings, Samsung C&T, NuScale Korea Holdings); 85% sharing of net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis adjustments on future Class B unit exchanges, NOLs generated by those adjustments, and imputed interest; 8-K files executed TRA as Exhibit 10.11

#### Fluor settlement and rate amendment

- 2025-11-06: Tax Receivable Agreement Amendment executed (Fluor signing alone as Supermajority TRA Holder under Section 6.07(b)(i)); the 85% rate is replaced with 42.5% solely for payments to Fluor and its Controlled Affiliates; other TRA Holders remain at 85%. Filed concurrently with a Project Neutron Exchange Agreement under which Fluor exchanges all 110,936,472 of its Class B units for Class A common stock, conditioned on a Charter Amendment doubling NuScale's authorized Class A share count

## Explanation

NuScale Power Corporation emerged from the May 2, 2022 SPAC business combination between Spring Valley Acquisition Corp. and NuScale Power, LLC and executed a Tax Receivable Agreement at closing obligating PubCo to pay 85% of net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis adjustments on future Exchanges of Class B units, the NOLs generated by those adjustments, and imputed interest, to Fluor Enterprises (TRA Representative and supermajority beneficiary) and eight other TRA Holders. On November 6, 2025, Fluor signed a TRA Amendment alone under the Section 6.07(b)(i) supermajority gate (Fluor's pre-amendment ETP share exceeded two-thirds) that halves its own payment rate from 85% to 42.5%; the other eight TRA Holders are unaffected and continue at 85%. The amendment was conditioned on a concurrent Exchange Agreement (Fluor converts all 110.9M Class B units to Class A), Charter Amendments roughly doubling authorized Class A share count, and a narrowing of the 2011 Exclusivity Agreement to permit NuScale's ENTRA1 partnership. NuScale has carried a full valuation allowance against the underlying DTAs since inception and has recorded no TRA liability or made any payments through FY 2025. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
